armyRules.name: Blessings of Khorne
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is ^^**World Eaters^^**, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne. Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.

Example: **Ash makes their Blessings of Khorne roll and gets the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6. First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4.
They then use the two 2s to activate Wrathful Devotion (which requires any double), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 3, 4.
However, now that they have activated two Blessings of Khorne, they cannot activate any more and the remaining dice are discarded.**

rule.name: Idols of Khorne
rule.text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active, and its effects apply to all ^^**World Eaters Titanic^^** and ^^**World Eaters Monster^^** units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.


**Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura)**
While a friendly ^^**Jakhals^^** or ^^**Goremongers^^** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is ^^**Titanic^^**), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.


**Idol of Burning Wrath (Aura)**
While a friendly ^^**Jakhals^^** or ^^**Goremongers^^** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is ^^**Titanic^^**), add 1" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.


**Idol of Blessed Blood (Aura)**
While a friendly ^^**Jakhals^^** or ^^**Goremongers^^** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is ^^**Titanic^^**), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.


^^**Jakhals^^** or ^^**Goremongers^^** units from your army have the ^^**Battleline^^** keyword.

Bloody Vengeance.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Bloody Vengeance.flavour: The demise of this titanic being showers nearby cultists in blood and viscera, inspiring vengeful fury.

Rapid Manifestation.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

Rapid Manifestation.text:

Warp Stalkers.target: One WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
Warp Stalkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rule.name: Blood Tithe
rule.text:
Each time a ^^**Blood Legions^^** or ^^**World Eaters^^** unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6; on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend 1 or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle.


**Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**
^^**Blood Legions^^** and ^^**World Eaters^^** models from your army have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.


**Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**
Melee weapons equipped by ^^**Blood Legions^^** units from your army have the [Lance] ability.


**Boon of Blood [4BTP]**
^^**Blood Legions^^** units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.


**Might of Khorne [5BTP]**
^^**Blood Legions^^** units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

Summoned by Slaughter.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play.
Summoned by Slaughter.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Daemonic Fury.flavour: The blood legions surge forth from the Warp in a howling tide of carnage, butchering all in their path.

drawntotheslaughter.flavour: As the bloodshed increases, Jakhals are drawn to the fight like hungry scavengers to a kill.

failnotthebloodgod.flavour: To fail Khorne is to invite a terrible fate.

aworthyskull.flavour: Khorne’s followers seek to claim the skulls of the foe's mightiest champions.

blessingofburningblood.flavour: The weapons of Khorne's craven foes are turned aside by empyric energies.

daemontide.flavour: As the bloodshed increases, seemingly endless tides of daemons spill from the Warp to bolster the ranks of the blood legions.

daemonicstrength.flavour: Infernal mutations grant the possessed daemonic strength.

horrifyingviolence.flavour: Enthralled warriors fall upon their victims in horrifying displays of carnage, sending panic rippling through the enemy ranks.

endlesspursuitofviolence.flavour: Having slaughtered their foes, the World Eaters mount up once more to seek new victims.

smashthrough.name: SMASH THROUGH

smashthrough.flavour: Few obstacles can prevent the World Eaters' eager armoured formations from reaching their prey.

aggressivedisembarkation.flavour: Propelled by their bloodlust, the World Eaters spill from their transports and surge towards the foe.

fullthrottleassault.flavour: With their transports growling with hunger, the World Eaters emerge rapidly to crash headlong into their enemies.

unrelentingadvance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.
unrelentingadvance.flavour: Incoming fire crashes against corrupted armour, drawing the target closer.

furyunleashed.name: FURY UNLEASHED
furyunleashed.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
furyunleashed.target: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
furyunleashed.effect: One KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within your model can make a disembark move and then make a surge move of up to D6+2".
furyunleashed.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.
furyunleashed.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: One KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within your model can make a disembark move and then make a surge move of up to D6+2".

RESTRICTION: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.
furyunleashed.flavour: Khorne Berzerkers react to incoming fire, disembarking to release their pent-up fury.

apoplecticclarity.name: APOPLECTIC CLARITY
apoplecticclarity.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to attack.
apoplecticclarity.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:

- BS.

- WS.

- Hit rolls and wound rolls.
apoplecticclarity.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:

- BS.

- WS.

- Hit rolls and wound rolls.
apoplecticclarity.flavour: So perfect a state of supernatural rage does this ironclad entity exist in that nothing can distract it from its single‑minded slaughter.

trailofdestruction.name: TRAIL OF DESTRUCTION
trailofdestruction.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to move.
trailofdestruction.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
trailofdestruction.flavour: Like a runaway engine of destruction, this Khornate war machine bulldozes a path through even the densest terrain in its urgency to reach the foe.

goadedtofury.name: GOADED TO FURY
goadedtofury.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) has shot.
goadedtofury.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
goadedtofury.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) has shot.

TARGET: That DAEMON VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
goadedtofury.flavour: Incensed by the cowardly affront of the foe, this war engine charges down those who would dare fire upon it.

focusedferocity.name: FOCUSED FEROCITY
focusedferocity.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
focusedferocity.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
focusedferocity.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
focusedferocity.flavour: Fighting with lunatic fierceness, these elite killers hack their victims limb from limb in a blizzard of blows.

atrophyforthethrone.name: A TROPHY FOR THE THRONE
atrophyforthethrone.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
atrophyforthethrone.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.
atrophyforthethrone.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.
atrophyforthethrone.flavour: The greater and more terrible the enemies these warriors face in battle, the mightier the trophies they can take in the Blood God’s name.

wrathbeyondreason.name: WRATH BEYOND REASON
wrathbeyondreason.when: Your opponent’s Shooting Phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
wrathbeyondreason.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
wrathbeyondreason.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting Phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
wrathbeyondreason.flavour: So seized by furious bloodlust are these killers that they fight on through even the most grievous mortal wounds.

scornthewitch.name: SCORN THE WITCH
scornthewitch.when: Any phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) suffers a mortal wound.
scornthewitch.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
scornthewitch.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
scornthewitch.flavour: Those who feel Khorne’s blessings burning through their bodies and minds can shrug off hostile witchery with the force of their hate-fuelled contempt.

aspiretoinfamy.name: ASPIRE TO INFAMY
aspiretoinfamy.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight.
aspiretoinfamy.effect:
Your unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks have:

- +1 A.

- +2 S.
aspiretoinfamy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight.

TARGET: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks have:

- +1 A.

- +2 S.
aspiretoinfamy.flavour: Feeling that the Blood God’s eye must surely be sweeping the field of war, his champions strive with wild ferocity to prove themselves.

punishthecraven.name: PUNISH THE CRAVEN
punishthecraven.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
punishthecraven.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle-shocked, -1 from those hazard rolls.
punishthecraven.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.

TARGET: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle-shocked, -1 from those hazard rolls.
punishthecraven.flavour: The Blood God is said to detest cowards. Meting out punishment to such degenerates is a sure way to win his favour and gain his wrathful boons.

terrifyingscreams.name: TERRIFYING SCREAMS
terrifyingscreams.when: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
terrifyingscreams.effect: Until the end of your opponent’s next Command phase, subtract 1 from Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for all enemy units.
terrifyingscreams.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That WORLD EATERS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of your opponent’s next Command phase, subtract 1 from Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for all enemy units.
terrifyingscreams.flavour: These warriors dismember their victims with such apocalyptic violence that the agonised screams of the dying ring throughout the ship.

unstoppablerage.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAGE
unstoppablerage.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) opens a Hatchway.
unstoppablerage.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, until the start of your next Movement phase, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in it makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
unstoppablerage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That WORLD EATERS unit.

EFFECT: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, until the start of your next Movement phase, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in it makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
unstoppablerage.flavour: Charging headlong into battle, these warriors simply smash hatches from their housings as they bull their way through, often straight into unsuspecting foes waiting in corridors and chambers beyond.

savageresilience.name: SAVAGE RESILIENCE
savageresilience.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
savageresilience.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
savageresilience.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
savageresilience.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
savageresilience.flavour: Lost to blood madness, these warriors cannot be halted even by ruinous salvoes of enemy fire.

cowardsbane.name: COWARDS’ BANE
cowardsbane.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
cowardsbane.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
cowardsbane.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.
cowardsbane.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army (excluding JAKHAL units) within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.
cowardsbane.flavour: Disgusted by those who seek to flee their axes, the World Eaters cut them down without mercy.

bloodrite.name: BLOOD RITE
bloodrite.when: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
bloodrite.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
bloodrite.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
bloodrite.flavour: Ground upon which Khorne’s champions have shed the blood of their foes is indelibly stained with the mark of their wrathful god.

furiousmomentum.name: FURIOUS MOMENTUM
furiousmomentum.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
furiousmomentum.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
furiousmomentum.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
furiousmomentum.flavour: Gripped by supernatural levels of fury, these warriors surge through the raging heart of battle like a bloody tide.

ruinousrampage.name: RUINOUS RAMPAGE
ruinousrampage.target: One WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
ruinousrampage.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
ruinousrampage.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
ruinousrampage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS TERMINATOR, EIGHTBOUND or EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
ruinousrampage.flavour: These berserk warriors smash through armoured hatchways as though they were no more durable than parchment.

shockingonslaught.name: SHOCKING ONSLAUGHT
shockingonslaught.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch.
shockingonslaught.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
shockingonslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch at your unit this phase.
shockingonslaught.text:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch.

TARGET: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is selected to fire Overwatch, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch at your unit this phase.
shockingonslaught.flavour: The horrifying onset of these warriors can paralyse enemies with fear at the crucial moment.
